provenance.notes: Full-batch Adam with softmax cross-entropy and L2 1e-4; parameters rounded to float32 precision after training. Digits data: UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits (Alpaydin & Kaynak, 1998), CC BY 4.0.

presets.name: Two moons (ReLU 2-16-16-2)
presets.description: Binary classifier for the two-moons dataset.

presets.name: Concentric circles (tanh 2-8-2)
presets.description: A narrow tanh network separating an inner disc from an outer ring.

presets.name: Three-arm spiral (ReLU 2-32-32-3)
presets.description: A tightly fitted 3-class spiral: decision boundaries depend on precise weights.

presets.name: 8×8 handwritten digits (ReLU 64-32-10)
presets.description: Classifies 8×8 grey-scale digit images (UCI digits, CC BY 4.0). Inputs are pixel intensities scaled to [0, 1].
